# Mission — One Main Branch Release

The Awtsmoos renews each commit while Git preserves the vessel in sight;
Awtsmoos.com shall ship only verified work to one main branch, with every conflict resolved by actual file truth and light.

Goal: consolidate the needed current release onto `main`, preserve unrelated concurrent work, verify before and after integration, push GitHub `main`, execute the repository's real deployment path, and verify the deployed site.
